description: This file defines the NodeDisplayName enum which provides utility functions for managing device display names based on device type, existing name, and interface idiom. It includes methods for checking whether a name is generic, resolving proper display names, and normalizing device names.

methods.name: isGeneric
methods.description: Checks if a given name is a generic device name.

methods.name: defaultValue
methods.description: Returns a default display name based on the device's interface idiom.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and returns the most appropriate display name based on existing name, device name, and interface idiom.

methods.name: normalizedDeviceName
methods.description: Normalizes the device name if it contains certain substrings related to Apple devices.
